data.long_description:
Provident proudly presents this exceptional one-bedroom apartment in DAMAC Towers by Paramount—an iconic address where luxury meets Hollywood-inspired design. This fully furnished residence showcases a spacious layout with premium finishes, refined interiors, and contemporary features that offer both elegance and comfort.

The apartment boasts a well-appointed bedroom, two stylish bathrooms, and a dedicated laundry room, providing utmost convenience for everyday living. Floor-to-ceiling windows illuminate the space with natural light while framing breathtaking views of the Creek and Canal, creating a serene and visually stunning atmosphere.

Property Features:

Fully furnished one-bedroom apartment
Two contemporary bathrooms
Separate laundry room
Open Creek and Canal views
High-end interiors designed by Paramount Hotels & Resorts
Spacious, thoughtfully planned layout
Covered parking
On-site supermarket

Amenities:

Multiple swimming pools, including a rooftop infinity pool
Fully equipped fitness center
Luxury spa facilities
Private cinema
Kids’ play area
24-hour security
24-hour valet parking
Restaurants and retail outlets within the complex
Prime Business Bay location
Easy access to Sheikh Zayed Road
Just 10 minutes from Dubai Mall and Burj Khalifa

Ideally located in the dynamic district of Business Bay, the property places you just 10 minutes away from Downtown Dubai, Dubai Mall, and the world-famous Burj Khalifa. DAMAC Towers by Paramount offers an unparalleled lifestyle experience with exceptional hospitality, state-of-the-art facilities, and a vibrant environment suitable for homeowners and investors alike.
